Speaker Arrival Guide · The Stage

How to Find Room 401 on 4F, Coex Conference Rooms (South)

After entering Coex on the 1st floor, follow the “Conference Rooms (South) 401–403” signs up to the 4th floor. From outside the building, the East Gate or South Gate 2 is the easiest way in.

Venue
Conference Rooms (South), Room 401
Registration Desk
4F Conference Rooms (South) lobby
Recommended entrances
East Gate · South Gate 2
Nearest subway
Line 2 Samseong · Line 9 Bongeunsa
STEP1

Head to the 1st floor of Coex

If you take the subway, head toward Coex via the connecting passage from Exit 5/6 of Samseong Station (Line 2) or from Exit 7 of Bongeunsa Station (Line 9). If you arrive from outside, use the East Gate or South Gate 2.

If you entered through the East Gate, keep going straight. The escalator up to the 4th floor is on the left side of the corridor ahead. Elevators are on both sides of the South Gate 2 passage.

  • Line 2 Samseong Station, passage toward Exit 5/6
  • Line 9 Bongeunsa Station, Exit 7
STEP2

Go up to 4F, Conference Rooms (South)

On the 1st floor, look for the “Conference Rooms (South) 401–403” sign, then take the escalator or elevator up to the 4th floor.

↑Conference Rooms (South) 401–403
STEP3

Arriving at Room 401

When you arrive on the 4th floor, you will see the Conference Rooms (South) lobby, across from the KITA Trade Academy (Korea International Trade Association). Room 401, the venue for The Stage, and the registration desk are in this lobby.

After getting off the escalator or elevator, follow the corridor out to the lobby. The registration desk is right in front of Room 401, and the entrance to Room 401 is through the passage to the left of the registration desk. If you took the elevator, turn once toward the escalator and follow the same route.

Coex · 513 Yeongdong-daero, Gangnam-gu, Seoul · Maps are for guidance only and may differ from the actual route.

Program

Full Timetable · Nov. 11 – 14
After 9:00 AM · Room #401 Lobby

Badge Pickup & Presentation Preparation

BADGE PICKUP — 30 MINUTES BEFORE PRESENTATION

  • The registration desk opens at 9:00 AM on Nov. 12.
  • After picking up your badge at the registration desk, you may wait in the VIP Room located across from Room 401. Our staff will guide you into the hall at the appropriate time.
  • Please be seated at least 30 minutes before your presentation in the speaker seats marked with a sticker at the side of the front row in Room 401.
  • With this badge, you’ll have access to the Cafe Show Seoul exhibition on the 1st and 3rd floors for all four days. If you would like to attend other sessions of the World Coffee Forum, please let the organizing committee know, and we will assist you with entry.

PRESENTATION PREPARATION

  • If you have any last-minute revisions, please bring the updated file on a USB to provide on-site, or you may hand over your MacBook to the console staff if necessary.
Room #401

Presentation

  • Each speaker session is scheduled for 30 minutes. Please keep your presentation within the assigned time.
  • Please be seated in the designated speaker section in Room 401 at least 30 minutes before your presentation. Occasionally, the previous speaker may finish early, and presentations may start slightly ahead of schedule.
  • Two monitors will be available below the stage. One will display your presentation as shown on the main screen, while the other will show the remaining presentation time.
  • Please use the presentation remote provided on-site to control your slides.
  • A wireless microphone will be provided. The audio team will manage the microphone settings during your presentation.
  • A joint panel talk with all five The Stage speakers will be held from 3:00 PM to 3:40 PM.
  • Interpretation receivers will not be provided. During the Q&A session, if the audience asks questions in Korean, the AI translation system will display the translated content on the stage monitor in real time.
11:30 – 13:00

Speaker Luncheon

  • A luncheon will be arranged for The Stage speakers.
  • Please follow the guidance of the Organizing Committee regarding the meeting point and venue.
14:00 – 14:30

Pairing Table

  • A coffee break will be held at the Pairing Table between the afternoon sessions.
  • Speakers are welcome to join the program before returning to Room 401 for the following sessions.
15:00 – 15:40 · Room #401

Panel Discussion

  • A panel discussion on the theme “Why We Drink Coffee” will take place.
  • All five speakers participating in The Stage will join the panel talk following the individual sessions.
  • Please remain in Room 401 and follow the guidance of the moderator and on-site staff.
  • Further details regarding the discussion topics and format will be shared separately.
15:40 – 16:00 · Room #401

Appreciation Plaque Ceremony

  • All five speakers participating in The Stage will join the panel talk following the individual sessions.
  • Please remain in Room 401 and follow the guidance of the moderator and on-site staff.
  • Further details regarding the discussion topics and format will be shared separately.
17:00 – 18:30

Asia-Pacific’s 100 Best Coffee Shops Gala

  • The Asia-Pacific’s 100 Best Coffee Shops Gala will be held from 5:00 PM to 6:30 PM.
  • Further details regarding the venue and attendance will be shared separately.
About Seoul

Weather

  • Korea has four distinct seasons, and November in Seoul is generally cool to cold.
  • The average temperature in November is around 9°C (48°F), with cooler temperatures in the mornings and evenings.
  • We recommend bringing warm, layered clothing and a jacket or coat.
  • Please check the latest weather forecast shortly before your trip, as temperatures may vary.
MORE INFORMATIONSeoul Metropolitan Government
About Seoul

Money

  • Korea’s official currency is the Korean won (KRW / ₩).
  • Common banknote denominations are ₩1,000, ₩5,000, ₩10,000, and ₩50,000.
  • Credit cards are widely accepted at hotels, department stores, restaurants, and most shops.
  • Exchange rates fluctuate, so we recommend checking the current exchange rate before your trip.
MORE INFORMATIONKorean Currency & Exchange – VISITKOREA
About Seoul

Electricity

  • Voltage: 220V / 60Hz
  • Socket type: two round-pin outlets are commonly used in Korea.
  • Depending on your device and country of origin, you may need a travel adapter.
  • Travel adapters can usually be purchased at airports, convenience stores, retail stores, or borrowed from some hotels.
MORE INFORMATIONElectricity & Communications – VISITKOREA
About Seoul

Transportation

Seoul has an extensive public transportation network, including subways, buses, and taxis. Information for international visitors is available in English through the Seoul Metropolitan Government and Visit Seoul websites.

A. TAXI

Taxis are widely available and can be hailed on the street or requested through mobile apps. Using an app is recommended, as you can enter your destination in advance and check your driver and vehicle information before pickup.

k.ride by Kakao MobilitySupports English, Chinese, and Japanese, with multilingual destination search and automatic translation chat with drivers.
k.ride
Uber TaxiThe Uber app can be used to request licensed local taxis in Seoul.
Uber Taxi Seoul

B. SUBWAY

  • One of the most convenient ways to travel around the city. Stations are numbered and color-coded, with multilingual information at major stations and ticket machines.
  • A Tmoney card can be used for subway and bus fares, and can be purchased and reloaded at subway stations and convenience stores.
  • For route planning and real-time information, we recommend NAVER Map, KakaoMap, or the official Seoul subway information services.

C. BUS

  • Seoul’s public bus network connects most areas of the city. A Tmoney card can also be used on buses.
  • Tap your card when both boarding and getting off, particularly when transferring between buses or the subway.
  • Real-time routes and arrival information are available on NAVER Map or KakaoMap. A navigation app is recommended if you are unfamiliar with Seoul.
MORE INFORMATION Seoul Metropolitan Government – Public Transportation Seoul Metropolitan Government – Subway NAVER Map KakaoMap
